hypothesis: The smallest continuous promotion-maturity weight that removes one additional preserved depth-3 cycle choice while changing 0/16 early roots and only 1/12 King hard cases should be tested over complete trajectories before any strategic claim. Unlike pure proximity, maturity keeps realized promotion value at King=1.0, so the trajectory test must verify it does not suppress actual promotions.
